newsitem.title: USA: RUBBERMAID NAMES HOME PRODUCTS PRESIDENT.
newsitem.headline: RUBBERMAID NAMES HOME PRODUCTS PRESIDENT.

text.p: Rubbermaid Inc said Monday that its Rubbermaid Europe President and General Manager Larry Porcellato, 39, will become president and chief operating officer of Rubbermaid's Home Products, North America Division, headquartered in Wooster, Ohio.
Porcellato is expected to expand product innovation and marketing in the household division, a news release issued by Rubbermaid said.

And the company said David Gibbons, 53, the president and general manager who has led the company's Home Products business since 1995, has been named president and general manager of Rubbermaid Europe, headquartered in Brussels.
The company said Gibbons' focus will be on building business relationships to secure the leading market position in Europe for Rubbermaid, as well as its Little Tikes and Graco businesses.
